summary_data.title: College Annual Function – Detailed Description
summary_data.summary: It serves as a platform to showcase the talents, achievements, and cultural diversity of students while also celebrating academic excellence and institutional success. - To encourage student participation in extracurricular activities - To recognize academic and non-academic achievements - To promote cultural values and teamwork - To provide a platform for talent showcase - Cultural performances (dance, music, drama) - Award distribution ceremony - Speeches by dignitaries - Student presentations - Fun and entertainment segments Students actively participate in performances and organization, while faculty members guide, supervise, and manage the event to ensure smooth execution.
key_points: To encourage student participation in extracurricular activities
To recognize academic and non-academic achievements
To promote cultural values and teamwork

Objectives

- To provide a platform for talent showcase  

3.

Event Planning

The event is planned weeks in advance.

Role of Students and Faculty

Students actively participate in performances and organization, while faculty members guide, supervise, 
and manage the event to ensure smooth execution.
